title: Padres vs. Cubs Wild Card Game 1 tonight at Petco Park
dek: The Padres host the Cubs at 7 p.m. Pacific in Game 1 of a best-of-three Wild Card Series, streaming on Peacock and NBCSN.
body: Baseball has its prime time game tonight on the West Coast. The San Diego Padres host the Chicago Cubs at Petco Park at 7 p.m. Pacific in Game 1 of their Wild Card Series.
It is a best-of-three series, so there is very little room for a slow start. If either team wins the first two games, there will be no Game 3. Tonight's game streams on Peacock and airs on NBCSN.
A playoff night game in San Diego has a special feel. Even on television, you can sense the crowd, the cool evening air and the nervous energy every time the count gets full.

Whether you root for the Padres, the Cubs or just good baseball, this is the kind of game that makes a Tuesday night feel special. It is also a nice excuse to invite someone over and share a bowl of popcorn.
If you are watching tonight, text a friend a score prediction before first pitch, and see who comes closer by the end.
